title: "My first weeks in MDS"
author: "Maxine Paredes"
date: 2026-09-10
---

![First day of school!](first_week.jpg)

We are now in our second week of the MDS program and I have been enjoying my time so far. While it holds up to its reputation as an accelerated program, I feel supported by the teaching team and am already learning so much. The immediate volume of work took me by surprise but I am also impressed by the amount of resources that are available to me. I am still trying to find the balance between school, relationships, health and wellness, clubs, and research but I am so excited for the opportunity to grow and build my skills.
